mapper.sql: SELECT c.*,o.display_name AS organization_name,hb.booking_code,ao.order_code,t.name AS trip_name,t.cover_image_url AS trip_cover_image_url,lm.content AS last_message_content,lm.message_type AS last_message_type,lm.sender_user_id AS last_message_sender_id,lm.sender_name AS last_message_sender_name,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_conversation_members mc WHERE mc.conversation_id=c.id AND mc.left_at IS NULL) AS member_count

FROM marketplace_conversations c LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id=c.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id=c.activity_order_id LEFT JOIN trips t ON t.id=c.trip_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT m.content,m.message_type,m.sender_user_id,lu.full_name AS sender_name FROM marketplace_messages m LEFT JOIN users lu ON lu.id=m.sender_user_id WHERE m.conversation_id=c.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.sequence_no DESC LIMIT 1) lm ON TRUE

(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_messages um LEFT JOIN marketplace_messages rm ON rm.id=cm.last_read_message_id WHERE um.conversation_id=c.id AND um.deleted_at IS NULL AND um.sequence_no>COALESCE(rm.sequence_no,0) AND um.sender_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{viewerId}) AS unread_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketplace_conversation_members(conversation_id,user_id,member_role,joined_at) VALUES(#{conversationId},#{userId},#{role},#{joinedAt}) ON CONFLICT(conversation_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET left_at=NULL,member_role=EXCLUDED.member_role
mapper.update: UPDATE marketplace_conversation_members SET left_at=#{at} WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND left_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM marketplace_conversation_members WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND left_at IS NULL AND (muted_until IS NULL OR muted_until<NOW())
SELECT user_id FROM marketplace_conversation_members WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND left_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE marketplace_conversation_members SET muted_until=#{mutedUntil} WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: ,cm.muted_until, LEFT JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{viewerId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL WHERE c.id=#{id}
,NULL::timestamp AS muted_until,0::bigint AS unread_count WHERE c.hotel_booking_id=#{id}
,NULL::timestamp AS muted_until,0::bigint AS unread_count WHERE c.activity_order_id=#{id}
,cm.muted_until, LEFT JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{viewerId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL WHERE c.trip_id=#{tripId}

,cm.muted_until, JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{viewerId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL WHERE c.status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND c.conversation_type IN#{item} ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST,c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_conversations c JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{viewerId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN marketplace_messages rm ON rm.id=cm.last_read_message_id WHERE c.status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND (cm.muted_until IS NULL OR cm.muted_until<NOW()) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_messages um WHERE um.conversation_id=c.id AND um.deleted_at IS NULL AND um.sequence_no>COALESCE(rm.sequence_no,0) AND um.sender_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{viewerId})

,cm.muted_until, LEFT JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{viewerId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL WHERE c.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND c.status=#{status} ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST,c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

,cm.muted_until, LEFT JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{viewerId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL WHERE c.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND c.status=#{status} AND CASE WHEN c.hotel_booking_id IS NOT NULL THEN hb.hotel_id IN #{hotelId}FALSE WHEN c.activity_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ao.activity_booking_id IN #{activityBookingId}FALSE ELSE TRUE END ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST,c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT hb.hotel_id FROM marketplace_conversations c JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id=c.hotel_booking_id WHERE c.organization_id=#{organizationId}
SELECT DISTINCT ao.activity_booking_id FROM marketplace_conversations c JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id=c.activity_order_id WHERE c.organization_id=#{organizationId}

,NULL::timestamp AS muted_until,0::bigint AS unread_count WHERE c.conversation_type <> 'TRIP' AND NOT (c.conversation_type='DIRECT' AND c.organization_id IS NULL) AND c.status IN#{item} AND c.conversation_type IN#{item} AND (o.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR hb.booking_code ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR ao.order_code ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY o.display_namehb.booking_codeao.order_codec.created_atc.last_message_at DESC NULLS LASTASC NULLS LAST,c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_conversations c LEFT JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{userId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id LEFT JOIN organization_members om ON om.organization_id=c.organization_id AND om.user_id=#{userId} AND om.member_status='ACTIVE' AND (om.valid_from IS NULL OR om.valid_from<=NOW()) AND (om.valid_until IS NULL OR om.valid_until>NOW()) WHERE c.id=#{conversationId} AND (cm.user_id IS NOT NULL OR o.owner_user_id=#{userId} OR om.user_id IS NOT NULL))
SELECT id FROM marketplace_conversations WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no),0)+1 FROM marketplace_messages WHERE conversation_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT m.*,u.full_name AS sender_name,u.avatar_url AS sender_avatar_url,ru.full_name AS reply_to_sender_name,r.content AS reply_to_content,r.message_type AS reply_to_message_type,r.deleted_at AS reply_to_deleted_at FROM marketplace_messages m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=m.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN marketplace_messages r ON r.id=m.reply_to_message_id LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.id=r.sender_user_id
mapper.select: WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.sender_user_id=#{senderId} AND m.client_message_id=#{clientId}
WHERE m.id=#{id}
WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.sequence_no>#{afterSequence} ORDER BY m.sequence_no LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ( WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.sequence_no<#{beforeSequence} ORDER BY m.sequence_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}) page ORDER BY sequence_no
WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.content ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') ORDER BY m.sequence_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketplace_conversations SET last_message_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE marketplace_conversation_members SET last_read_message_id=#{messageId} WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_messages WHERE id=#{messageId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId}) AND (last_read_message_id IS NULL OR COALESCE((SELECT sequence_no FROM marketplace_messages WHERE id=#{messageId}),0)>COALESCE((SELECT sequence_no FROM marketplace_messages WHERE id=last_read_message_id),0))

UPDATE marketplace_conversations SET status=COALESCE(#{status},status),assigned_member_id=CASE WHEN #{unassign} THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(#{assignedMemberId},assigned_member_id) END,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE marketplace_messages SET deleted_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{messageId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE marketplace_messages SET deleted_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{messageId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND sender_user_id=#{senderId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE marketplace_messages SET content=#{content},edited_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{messageId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND sender_user_id=#{senderId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketplace_message_reactions(message_id,user_id,emoji,created_at) VALUES(#{messageId},#{userId},#{emoji},#{at}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM marketplace_message_reactions WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND emoji=#{emoji}
mapper.select: SELECT rx.message_id,rx.user_id,rx.emoji,u.full_name AS user_name FROM marketplace_message_reactions rx LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=rx.user_id WHERE rx.message_id IN #{messageId} ORDER BY rx.message_id,rx.emoji,rx.created_at LIMIT 2000

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_conversations c LEFT JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{viewerId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN marketplace_messages rm ON rm.id=cm.last_read_message_id WHERE c.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND c.status IN ('OPEN','PENDING') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_messages um WHERE um.conversation_id=c.id AND um.deleted_at IS NULL AND um.sequence_no>COALESCE(rm.sequence_no,0) AND um.sender_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{viewerId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_conversations c WHERE c.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND c.status IN ('OPEN','PENDING')

SELECT m.conversation_id, m.user_id, u.full_name, u.username, u.avatar_url, m.member_role FROM marketplace_conversation_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.left_at IS NULL AND m.conversation_id IN #{conversationId} ORDER BY m.conversation_id, m.joined_at, m.user_id LIMIT 500
